title: Return Orders
subtitle: TikTok Shop return / refund requests synced from the Return & Refund API.
noPermission: You do not have permission to view return orders.
neverSynced: Not synced yet — press Sync Now or wait for the scheduled sync.
searchPlaceholder: Search by Order ID or Return ID…
empty: No return / refund requests match the current filters.
orderNotSynced: This order has not been synced into POD Orders yet.
noItems: TikTok returned no line items for this request.
paidUnavailable: Not every requested line could be matched to a synced order line, so the paid amount is not shown (the order total is never used instead).

amount.settledOrderHint: Order-level revenue TikTok reversed in a settled statement because of refunds. It is already included in Est. Revenue / Profit.

summary.settledHint: Revenue reversed in settled statements (each order once)
summary.orders: {{orders}} order(s) with requests · {{refunded}} order(s) refunded · {{quantity}} item(s) in open / completed requests

history.title: Refund history
history.empty: TikTok returned no history records for this request.
history.liveFailed: Could not load the latest history from TikTok — showing the last saved copy.

sync.noShops: No active TikTok shop in your scope to sync.

syncError.RETURN_SCOPE_MISSING: the app is not authorized for Return & Refund (seller.return_refund.basic). Enable the scope in TikTok Partner Center, then re-authorize the TikTok connection.
syncError.REAUTH_REQUIRED: the TikTok authorization expired — re-authorize the connection in TikTok Accounts.
syncError.SHOP_NOT_FOUND: the shop is no longer linked.
syncError.RATE_LIMITED: TikTok rate limit — will retry on the next sync.
syncError.TIKTOK_UNAVAILABLE: TikTok did not respond — will retry on the next sync.
syncError.PAGE_LIMIT: too many requests in one run — the rest syncs on the next run.
syncError.ALREADY_RUNNING: a sync for this shop is already running.
syncError.UNKNOWN: unexpected error — see Sync status for details.

scopeWarning.title: Some shops cannot sync return / refund data
scopeWarning.hint: Their requests are NOT shown as zero — they simply could not be read. Fix the authorization, then press Sync Now.
